name: Tatous
source:
Tatous – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Tatous is a mature orange-eyed short green om'verai with a short "beard" and white plates on both belly and paws. Tatous have 2 bull-styled head horns, silver head plates and forehead spikes. Tatous wears a monocular on his right eye - either for vision enhancing or as a tool.
Tatous is a teacher, able to take responsibility for children, as well as their science projects. Helps young aeisologysts to reach Areth City for further education purposes.
